title: The canonical two-label family evaluates to the chart comparisons
statement: There exists a simultaneous AffineCoordinateComparisonFamily [def-pc-affine-coordinate-comparison-data] whose component at either Boolean label is the chart object comparison constructed in [lem-pc-affine-coordinate-derived-comparison] at the corresponding complex. This is an explicit construction, natural on the full induced category including cross morphisms. The equality of components is definitional; no composition law is assumed here.

source.place: Tag 08DW(2) natural affine comparison restricted to two supplied models.

proof.text: Use affineCoordinateDerivedComparison as the family. Its components are defined by the stated chart object comparisons. After introducing the coordinate square, models, their K-flatness proofs, and the label, reflexivity proves the component equality.

lean.statement: theorem exists_affineCoordinateComparisonFamilyBase : ∃ δ : AffineCoordinateComparisonFamily.{u, w}, ∀ (a b : AffineComparisonCoordinate.{u, w}) (φ : a.A →+* b.A) (p : b.X ⟶ a.X) (hp : b.σ.hom ≫ p = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ a.σ.hom) (M N : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} a.A) ℤ) (hM : AffineComparisonKFlat a.A M) (hN : AffineComparisonKFlat a.A N) (j : Bool), (δ a b φ p hp M N hM hN).app j = affineCoordinateChartObjectComparison a b φ p hp (cond j M N) (by cases j <;> assumption)
